referee_caveats_inferred: Fits have no proper posterior or likelihood: occultation uses a grid with flat acceptance windows, the joint fit gives 1 sigma errors with no stated method and p = 0.59 lies outside the physical range
Only one ALMA band and one VLA band; model degeneracies (B, p, R) are unbroken
Only 4 ALMA execution blocks over two days with gaps; Gaussian-process interpolation drives the IR-submm lag result
Periodogram significance depends on the assumed red-noise slope and on excluding a Spitzer wobble origin
ALMA ACA baselines >= 20 klambda cut and self-cal assumptions affect the light-curve amplitudes without a stated flux-scale uncertainty
